| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| A2 | 1 | 1 | -1 |
| E | 2 | -1 | 0 |

The characters in the table represent the trace of the corresponding representation matrices. The characters of the identity operation (E) are always equal to 1.
